candidates.change_summary: Replace ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with a different constant value, changing the returned bytes32.
Remove the revert statement, making notDelegated do nothing, which allows proxiableUUID to be called from a delegatecall and return the proxy's implementation slot instead of reverting.
Delete the call to __Access_init(_accessControl) so the accessControl address is never set, causing all checkAccess modifiers to always fail afterward.
Delete the call to __UUPSUpgradeable_init() so the UUPS initializer is skipped, altering the initialization state and leaving the contract in an uninitialized UUPS state.
Replace __Access_init(_accessControl) with __Access_init(address(0)) so accessControl is set to zero address, causing all checkAccess modifiers to deny access.
Delete the state update `$._initialized = 1;` so the contract will still be uninitialized after initializer completes, allowing re-initialization and changing behavior.
Replace `$._initialized = 1;` with `$._initialized = 2;` so the initialized version is set to 2 instead of 1, changing the version checked by reinitializer.
Delete the condition that checks `initialSetup` and `construction`, so initializer can run even when already initialized, altering re-initialization protection.
Replace 'elapsed = block.timestamp - utilizationData.lastUpdate;' with 'elapsed = block.timestamp - utilizationData.lastUpdate + 1;' to alter the interest rate calculation.
Replace 'if (block.timestamp > utilizationData.lastUpdate)' with 'if (true)' to always enter the update branch, changing elapsed and utilization calculations.
Replace 'if (elapsed != block.timestamp)' with 'if (false)' to always use IVault(_vault).utilization(_asset) for utilization when entering the update branch.
Delete 'utilizationData.index = index;' so the stored index is not updated, affecting future utilization calculations.
Delete 'utilizationData.lastUpdate = block.timestamp;' so lastUpdate is never updated, causing the else branch to be taken permanently after the first update.
